angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 586,475 km at 84.50 pc = 0.09 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 11.8342 +/- 0.0208 mas (same row, RUWE 1.24): 84.50 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.843 +/- 0.005 solar radii from Piotto et al. 2024, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-561 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.535.2763P/abstract): 586,475 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.806 +/- 0.036 solar masses from Piotto et al. 2024, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-561 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024MNRAS.535.2763P/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5342 +/- 57 K from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of TOI-561 b's parameter set from MacDougall et al. 2023 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of TOI-561 b's parameter set from MacDougall et al. 2023 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-561.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.493, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-561 (pscomppars): spectral type G9 V, from Lacedelli et al. 2022 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2022MNRAS.511.4551L/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, TOI-561: main object type MS*, Main Sequence Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-561 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.41 dex, from Brinkman et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....165...88B/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-561 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.28233, from Brinkman et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....165...88B/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-561 (pscomppars): age 16.1 Gyr, from Polanski et al. 2024 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024ApJS..272...32P/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: VizieR J/A+A/661/A101/tableb4 (Magnetic moments of rocky planets), column Prot: 77.229 d, the row 0.0 arcsec from the star's J2000 place
